carrier_answer.question: Is the existing 16-byte little-endian u128 carrier permissible for this local positive leaf without adopting a B serialized profile, limb width, counters or state caps?
carrier_answer.regA_and_payload: h.regA and ConstRow/DataRow U128.n are UInt128. Their 16-byte little-endian encoding, with each byte in [0,255], is normative in /primitive_types/UInt128. The value is the sum of b_i * 256^i, which lies in [0, 2^128). The leaf copies bytes one for one and range-checks each to 8 bits. No packing, limb split or field selection is involved.
carrier_answer.counters: remainingWork, consumedWork, helperWork and helperVisits have host type u128 (/primitive_types/Nat), so their range is [0, 2^128 - 1]. A 16-byte LE carrier represents that range injectively. This is a LOCAL logical carrier only. It is NOT the WidthTable counterWidths, AD-2a, WorkCounter or HelperCounter serialized width. Connecting it to any serialized width is the caller's OBL-07.
carrier_answer.semantic_subranges_not_enforced: remainingWork + consumedWork = initialFuel <= maxReferenceWork and helperWork <= maxHelperWork (SI-03) are external. The leaf enforces only carrier range, exact +/-1, and no wrap at 2^128 (the final carry or borrow is 0).
carrier_answer.gadget_style: This is the literal_step.rs bytewise borrow chain (9-bit intermediates, carry = 256*next) plus its increment dual. The redundant all-zero chain of literal_step is omitted: a final borrow of 0 is equivalent under enable.
carrier_answer.deviation_from_A_style: literal_step range-checks every image cell unconditionally. This leaf instead checks its own helper and counter lanes through eff(x) = CondSelect(enable, x, 0), because the B register and counter layout (including any union overlay) is not frozen. Under enable = 1 the relation is identical. Unconditional ranging remains a composer option.
carrier_answer.field_fact_relied_on: SDK Native modulus p > 2^128. The reused emit_enabled_fetch_block already relies on this for LessThan{bits:128} and ConstrainBits 128. It implies p > 511, which the 9-bit byte equalities need. This is an unverified fact about the pinned SDK Fr, not a B fieldId selection; L04 stays open.

enable_truth_scope.owner_definition: enable = 1 asserts, and only the composer's constrained dispatch over the bound pre-image may assert, that the step is the Applied event of b.helper.Scalar.tag on its RetRight/Add/First/UInt branch. Concretely: AB holds (host); outcome is Running (P0); P1 and P2 do not fire; PS selects Scalar.tag; P3 does not fire (helperWork < maxHelperWork); and kind(deref(h.operandA)) = UInt.
checked_in_leaf_under_enable: helper present = 1, kind = Scalar, site = RetRight, mode = Add, phase = First. On a StepInv pre-image these make /dispatch/helper_groups/Scalar return Scalar.tag uniquely (construct and arithmetic select_when are false) and exclude P1.
remainingWork >= 1 (the final borrow is 0), so a P2 image is unsatisfiable when enabled
operandA.index < active length of its space, and that row's space tag = U128 (kind UInt, D-23 realized per space)

The only unconditional requirements are those emit_enabled_fetch_block imposes on each nonzero-capacity value table: each projected cell < 2^128 and active_rows <= capacity. No canonical-inactive or zeroing rule is emitted, and none is claimed.

caller_obligations.text: AB: step only with the image's own Admitted (SI-01, D-32). Host-only; the encoded form is open.
enable = 0 unless pre.outcome = Running and pre.helperWork < bounds.maxHelperWork, which routes P0 and P3 to their own branches.
enable is derived from the constrained pre-state selector, never from a free witness or expected data. Exactly one enable across the whole step relation.

pre_helper and post_helper are exact aliases of the bound pre and post reg.helper lanes. The typed lanes are the named fields; rest is the complete remaining partition (nothing omitted or duplicated) in identical order pre and post. Discriminator lanes hold the schema Enum ordinals and the space lane holds the ValueRef bit; a layout using other codes invalidates this leaf until re-review.

The value tables are all physical rows of the bound ProgramView prog.constants and the pre img.data, projected exactly to the variant tag ordinal lane and the U128.n byte lanes, with the true active lengths. Every projected cell is < 2^128 in every image where the fragment appears, whatever the value of enable.

Every pre/post cell outside this leaf is equal under enable: reg.control, controlOrigin, envRoot, depth, stackLimit, outcome, initialFuel, referenceCursor (D-09R), alloc.*, active.*, taskLive, result, segBase, and every image table and slot. Delta entries 4-10 are zero.
The counter and regA carriers are connected to the eventual serialized encodings by explicit constraints, because counterWidths and WidthTable are not frozen. Until then the carriers are local only.
StepInv on the pre-image is external (SI-03, SI-04, SI-08 result absent, SI-13, SI-17, SI-21 including operandA = top.left and site coherence, and SI-22 S1). Post-StepInv preservation is not claimed.

Program, pre and post statement binding and field embedding are external (L04 open). This is a mid-helper image, so it is never a canonical boundary (D-30); proof splits link physical images directly.
Every operand is bound before the fragment. The composer reserves the %{scope}. namespace non-nested against all other blocks.

Any bound event envelope or StepEvent records ruleId b.helper.Scalar.tag, HelperVisit, Applied, work/helperWork/helperVisits deltas 1/1/1, cursor delta 0, zero alloc and value-slot writes, and helperPhase First to Second. None of this is emitted here.
When enable = 0 the post lanes are determined by whichever branch is enabled, not by this leaf.
